item.text:
The views indicate a plate in the YZ plane, with thickness along X. I’m using equal arm spans, a strip width about one-fifth of the span, and five equal holes.

[Live CAD view](http://127.0.0.1:8770/#part.FCStd)

item.text: The preview showed that the plate needed to lie in XZ; I’ve corrected the orientation to match all four views. Validation reports one solid with five equal through-holes. I’m exporting the STEP file now.
